relevance_note: Case report of two males with LAMP2 variants: 'The genetic analysis detected a pathogenic heterozygous mutation (c.973delC) in the LAMP2 gene, which confirmed a diagnosis of Danon disease'.
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script from my own reading. Table 1 has patients as columns (headers 'Patient I', 'Patient II'); spans quote the row from its label through the patient's cell, often the full row including the normal range. Labels: 'Patient I'/'Patient II' are the most frequent forms (also written 'Patient 1'/'Patient 2'). CONTRADICTION: c.973delC in Patient I is called 'heterozygous' in the case text and 'hemizygous' in the following paragraph; zygosity left 'not reported'. Patient I inheritance recorded de novo because both parents were tested and lacked the variant (text plus Figure 4 legend); the paper itself says 'assumed to be de novo'. Patient I 'No skeletal muscle strength or mental abnormalities': muscle-strength absence recorded as excluded feature but the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' left not reported, because the broader skeletal myopathy item is not excluded (biopsy shows vacuoles; table note links CK to myopathy); 'mental abnormalities' taken to exclude the intellectual disability/cognitive item only. Reduced LVEF (34%/14.3%; 23%) recorded as reduced ejection fraction from the stated values. Elevated LDH/MBB/CK read from Table 1 values against its Normal Range column. Patient II 'weakness' is general, not recorded as proximal muscle weakness; heart failure not stated despite referral to a Heart Failure Center. Patient II genomic coordinate 'chrX-119602990' from Figure 4 legend (no build given). Patient II maternal grandfather ('died at 36 in unexplained circumstances') not given a row: neither tested nor stated affected. Literature persons given rows: ref 18 explanted-heart patient; ref 14 family (three brothers and their mother, elevated cTnI as a named group, sex stated); ref 23 patient with AF and stroke at 30. Not given rows: Antopol (ref 12) two brothers (diagnosis only hedged 'may have been'); count-only statements (2/50, 4/6, 5/7, Japanese survey 10%, Spanish registry 11/27). Table S1 (literature table) is not in the file.
